name: Collection Effectiveness Index
summary: Collection Effectiveness sits below the 90% target. The biggest levers are promise-to-pay conversion and dunning response — both lift sharply once the AI worklist and smart-dunning agents are fully adopted.

drivers.name: Promise-to-pay conversion
drivers.narrative: 2 of 7 promises kept; broken promises re-age receivables.
drivers.rootCause: Promises captured on calls were not systematically tracked; the Promise-to-Pay agent now follows up automatically on the promised date.

drivers.name: Dunning response rate
drivers.narrative: Share of outreach that gets a response or payment.
drivers.rootCause: Generic, mistimed dunning had low engagement; GenAI personalisation and optimal send-time lift response materially.

drivers.name: Collector effectiveness
drivers.narrative: Effectiveness varies across the team and the AI auto-collector.
drivers.rootCause: Manual prioritisation spread effort thinly; the AI worklist concentrates collectors on the highest-recovery accounts.
